bagPolicy.summary: The City of Dallas theatre site and its presenting partner’s Majestic venue page do not publish a bag size or clear-bag policy for this theatre.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: City guidance lists metered street parking and nearby commercial facilities, including Elm Street Garage at 2000 Elm Street and Platinum Parking at 2009 Elm Street. Prices vary by garage.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Majestic Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The venue’s presenting partner lists lobby concessions with soft drinks, beer, wine, liquor and light snacks. Drinks may be carried into the auditorium for most events, subject to the show’s rules.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Guests can be dropped off on Elm Street for lobby access, and an elevator serves all theatre levels. Rear Orchestra seats offer the easiest performance-hall access for guests with mobility needs.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The City of Dallas Majestic information does not publish a specific leave-and-re-enter policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The City of Dallas event calendar links to different ticket sellers, but it does not publish one universal will-call pickup procedure for the theatre.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The City of Dallas event calendar does not publish a fixed opening time for Majestic Theatre doors; check the specific performance.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
